programs.title: Break Ke Baad
programs.desc: Aaliya is not ready for commitment even after a decade-long friendship with Abhay. She remains indifferent when he follows her to Australia, but is finally shaken when he announces his marriage.

programs.desc: Undercover agent Wali Khan and his team target D-Company's leader, Goldman. Facing betrayals and danger, they stage a bold escape into India, reshaping the underworld's power dynamics.
